author: Stan Horwitz
text: I just did a migration from my old iPhone 15 Pro Max to my brand new iPhone 17 Pro Max. Everything transferred over seamlessly including the Bluetooth connection to my sensor and the history as well as the LibreLinkUp and the Shuggaah apps that link up to Apple Health and my Apple Watch.

author: Gene Holcombe
text: It won’t transfer to your new phone in the middle of the period.  Wait until you start a new sensor to do the transfer
